subject: electrical
question: What is the smallest fix?
note: Follows armpower-why-fix in the same conversation; cards count across the thread (the fix loop may offer one on the Why turn). A card whose engine comparison clears a violation and adds none: what suggest-fixes keeps, so it holds with or without that tool. verify proves two such changes exist (w.servo-feed 28 -> 22 AWG clears the brown-out; the fuse 9 -> 7 A clears the fuse finding). suggest-fixes is served. A card passes when it is one of suggest-fixes' fixes in the thread OR its own engine comparison clears a violation and adds none; passing on the second only prints a NOTE, and a search not run is a NOTE (searched), not a failure.

subject: electrical
question: And the fuse?
note: The demo script's fourth step. Names the 7 A the check prints; the thread holds a clean card (what-if proves the fuse at 7 A clears it). suggest-fixes is served. A card passes when it is one of suggest-fixes' fixes in the thread OR its own engine comparison clears a violation and adds none; passing on the second only prints a NOTE, and a search not run is a NOTE (searched), not a failure. The card must change the fuse (rail.battery current_limit) or the pack wire (w.pack): a card that clears the brown-out instead does not answer "And the fuse?" (cardDiff).
